event_summary: A black-and-yellow striped upper cylinder descends onto a brown mound on a round platform, and the mound becomes shorter and wider.
raw_event_description: At the start, a brown curled mound sits upright on the center of a round platform while a striped cylindrical tool is suspended above it with a visible gap. The upper cylinder moves downward, contacts the top of the mound, and continues lower. As contact continues, the mound loses height, the curled top bends and disappears under the cylinder, and the brown material spreads outward into a flatter rounded stack. By the end, the striped cylinder remains low above the platform with the brown object flattened between it and the platform.

reasons: The upper cylinder, brown mound, and lower platform are all clearly visible.
A visible air gap separates the upper cylinder from the brown mound.
The brown mound appears upright and not yet flattened.
